facts.value: Open the Taught Programmes, choose the programme of your choice, read 'Entry Requirements' to find out the documents required to be uploaded with your application, click the Apply button, choose the programme option, create a username and password, upload required documents, pay an application fee of €50, and submit your application.
At the time of applying, applicants must upload their educational documents. UL graduates do not need to upload UL Transcripts.
The application fee must be paid through the portal and cannot be submitted via TransferMate.
